workflow_details.description: Add information that will help to differentiate this workflow from another.
workflow_details.title: Workflow Details

data_source.description: Select one of your configured data sources.

event_type.title: Event type
event_type.description: The event type to upload. Enter its value (e.g. giraffe_survey_encounter_nam) or its name as shown in EarthRanger.

action.title: Action
action.description: Make template: save a blank CSV template and field guide for this event type. Check file only: check your filled CSV and list any problems (nothing is sent). Check and import: check the CSV, then create the rows that passed in EarthRanger.

csv_path.title: CSV file (full path)
csv_path.description: Full path to your filled CSV on this computer (not needed for Make template), e.g. C:\Users\me\Documents\sightings.csv

time_zone.title: Time zone of the times in your CSV
time_zone.description: Time zone of the times in your CSV, e.g. Africa/Johannesburg, Africa/Windhoek, Africa/Nairobi or UTC. Times with their own zone (ending in Z or +02:00) keep it.
